experience.title: Software Engineer, Full-time

Started as one of two full-stack developers, key responsibilities include Requirement analysis from clients, design and implementation of both hardware and software architectures. Most projects involve AWS with Lambda/EC2/S3/CloudFront/SES/SNS integrations using SQL/NOSQL databases with a HTML/JS frontend which I used to solely maintain, mostly for legacy reasons. However, decided to transition to using Azure and Microsoft services, .Net and Blazor framework to create a multi-platform fully integrated streaming service to accommodate the shifting climate in live events.
